title: Ensure the repository publishes a security policy (SECURITY.md)
description: A security policy tells whoever finds a flaw where to send it and what to expect. Without one, reports either go nowhere or go public. Azure Repos does not surface a SECURITY.md specially, but it is still the first file a reporter looks for.
remediation: Add a SECURITY.md at the repository root (or under .github/ or docs/) on the default branch, stating where to report a vulnerability, which versions are supported, and the expected response time. Adjust which paths count with securityPolicyPaths in azure-devops-bench's config.
fixSummary: Add a SECURITY.md at the repository root on the default branch.
